chunks: And it is narrated from ʿAlī ibn Suwayd, who said:
I said to Abū al-Ḥasan al-Māḍī عليه السلام: "These people ask me to testify against my brothers."
He عليه السلام said: "Yes, establish the testimony for them, even if you fear harm for your brother."

key_terms.أَقِمِ الشَّهَادَةَ: render or uphold the testimony properly
key_terms.إِخْوَانِي: my brothers; those with close familial or fraternal ties
key_terms.الْمَاضِي: a title used here for Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام
key_terms.ضَرَرًا: harm or injury that may befall someone
key_terms.يُشْهِدُنِي: they ask me to bear witness or testify

ai.seo_question: Must a person give testimony even if it may harm his own brother?
ai.summary: This hadith instructs that testimony is to be given when required, even when it concerns one's own brothers and may lead to harm for them. It emphasizes the duty of truthful witness-bearing and the priority of justice over personal attachment.
